one_liner: Hosted web‑scraping and automation platform; you run “Actors” via a REST API and fetch structured results from storages.
access_notes: free signup yields API tokens; free monthly credits, no card
mcp_notes: vendor‑hosted server at https://mcp.apify.com with OAuth or bearer token auth; also a local stdio server and official GitHub repo

evidence.quote: “To access the Apify API in your integrations, you need to authenticate using your secret API token.” … “You can authenticate the Apify API in two ways. You can either pass the token via the Authorization HTTP header or the URL token query parameter.”
“Sign up for an Apify account. The free plan includes monthly platform usage credits with no credit card required.”
“You can download the complete OpenAPI schema of the Apify API in the YAML or JSON formats.”
“Webhooks provide an easy and reliable way to configure the Apify platform to carry out an action (e.g. a HTTP request to another service) when a certain system event occurs.”
“The Apify's MCP server (mcp.apify.com) allows AI applications and agents to interact with the Apify platform using Model Context Protocol (MCP).”
